lastCompletedStory.title: Bound the ship-PR body tempfile under one fixed reused parent

nextStoryContext: US-001 (Site 1 of 5, CAM-510, ship-pr temp body) is fully implemented and verified DONE on this 5th dispatch: local HEAD (551e5d63) and origin/cam/issue-510 are now IDENTICAL (confirmed via git fetch + rev-parse, both resolve to 551e5d63) -- the branch-divergence blocker recorded across the 4 prior dispatches' openQuestions (local chain diverged from an origin chain that had US-001..US-004 already finalized under different SHAs) is RESOLVED; no reconciliation action was needed or taken this dispatch, the remote ref simply now matches local HEAD. Implementation: src/release/ship-pr-tempfile.ts (writeShipPrTempFile) writes under a single fixed, reused parent join(tmpdir(), 'cam-ship-pr'), nested one level by process pid, with stale-sibling pruning (GOTCHA 8) that never touches the live process's own pid dir or the shared temp root itself (GOTCHA 5). Wired into src/commands/sidecar.ts:1201 (buildProductionShipPrStepDeps) replacing the old mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'cam-ship-pr-')) call. All gates verified green this dispatch: AC1 grep (no mkdtempSync rooted in tmpdir() in sidecar.ts) empty-match as required, AC2 test/release/ship-pr-tempfile.test.ts 3/3 pass, file-size ratchet ok (sidecar.ts is now 3717 lines, UNDER its existing 3722 ceiling -- the module extraction actually shrank the file, so no budget raise or CAM-510 _ref entry was needed; AC3's oracle (bun scripts/check-file-sizes.ts) passes without one), typecheck clean, full bun test 6074 pass / 0 fail, full bun run check:all spine green (lint/coverage/debt-markers/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps/test-tmpdir/skip-ratchet all ok). Next dispatch should proceed to Site 2 of 5 per the CAM-510 issue spec (see prd.json notes for the next story) with no special handling required; the branch is in a clean, pushed, in-sync state.

officialDocsValidated.summary: os.tmpdir() resolves from TMPDIR (POSIX) with no documented process-lifetime caching; this story's design depends on it re-reading TMPDIR per call so a test can redirect it via process.env.TMPDIR before invoking writeShipPrTempFile. Behavior reconfirmed empirically this dispatch (bun test test/release/ship-pr-tempfile.test.ts, 3/3 pass with TMPDIR redirected at call time), consistent with the CAM-508 handoff's prior empirical measurement on bun 1.3.13 that os.tmpdir() re-reads TMPDIR on every call. Carried forward unchanged from the prior dispatch's validation since no code changed this dispatch.
